title: Soldiers were Yellowstone's first tour guides #Shorts
description:
Fifteen infantry soldiers stationed at Old Faithful started explaining the geysers to visitors. Park historians say those talks were the beginning of what rangers still do today.

▶ Full documentary (Part 2, When the Cavalry Guarded the Geysers): https://youtu.be/P99Gu3GCZVw

#Shorts #Yellowstone #NationalParks #History
